exposure: presence of a household member with known SARS-CoV-2 infection
cohort: The study included 2945 women admitted for labour and delivery at four hospitals in Massachusetts between April 19, 2020, and June 27, 2020.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection in parturients was largely concentrated in patients with distinct demographic characteristics, particularly those from disadvantaged communities, and was associated with specific social and clinical factors.
